title: Magazine p. 57: Skylab III photo SL3-118-2140 and variations with erroneous captions
description: Photocopied magazine page with four photographs (numbered 29-32); most are washed-out blank frames, while photo 30 shows a small elongated object marked by an arrow. Captions read "NASA photo (right) SL3-118-2140 and variations (above and below) as published with erroneous captions" and "Shot during Sky Lab III second manned Sky Lab Flight 263 day of 1973—1645 Zulu Time... Listed as unidentified object or satellite by NASA Photo Evaluation Lab." Article text covers the "Fawcett list" of astronaut sightings, Gemini-XII debris and the Mercury-7 and Mercury-9 cases, with a handwritten note "see plate 21."
